intro: Between April 8 and May 1, 2026, ZCyberNews published 31 articles under the ai tag, covering threat actors Bluekit and Pushpaganda. The top affected sectors included technology, financial services, critical infrastructure, and email providers, with impacts reported across Global, the United Kingdom, the United States, Asia, and Australia. The severity mix comprised 5 medium, 13 high, 12 informational, and 1 critical incident.
